image_qa.note: All three new editorial bodies are intentionally image-free. Their only image element is the existing Big Bud Man logo in shared site chrome; no product, edible, package, cultivar, or affiliate image is represented or linked.

search_console.decision: The report covered August 24 through September 20: 518 impressions, one click, 0.2% CTR, and average position 61.6. The only position 4-20 page rows had one to four impressions, so no data-led rewrite was justified; those tiny samples and the single Oklahoma query click were deliberately ignored. Old submitted-sitemap errors were checked against the current live sitemap, feed, and site index rather than treated as a new topic signal.

authority.action: Published an FDA- and CDC-grounded delta-8 product identity, exact-lot, conversion-evidence, claims, help, and reporting worksheet; added reciprocal paths from Cannabis 101 and the product-reporting guide. Published a separate FDA- and New York OCM-grounded edible allergen record that keeps ingredients, major allergens, cross-contact language, cannabinoid fields, lot evidence, and emergency readiness in one checkout screen. Added an image-withheld Stem Cell CBG field note that distinguishes breeder identity, CBG and CBGA rows, production testing, finished products, claims, and law; linked it through the CBG field-note network. Food Allergy Research & Education and Oregon State University Global Hemp Innovation Center were logged as qualified factual-review or resource-library opportunities; no outreach was sent.
